name: Classic Manager: Football
summary: Classic Manager: Football is a text-based football (soccer) management game for iOS and Android, inspired by the PC management sims of the 1990s. The player takes charge of a club, sets tactics and changes them during matches, which are presented as live text commentary, and handles transfers, contracts and finances. Careers can start in the 1997/98, 2001/02 or 2026/27 season, with leagues, domestic cups and European competition across ten countries: England, Scotland, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Portugal, Turkey and Israel. Player potential is hidden and judged through performance. The game plays fully offline.
